intro.h2: The contractor Pottstown neighbors call back
paragraphs: Independence Renovations LLC. does bathroom remodeling in Pottstown, along with kitchens, tile, decks and repairs. Its Facebook page says the company specializes in bathroom and kitchen renovations, and customers deal directly with Nick, who handles the carpentry, tile and plumbing himself.

The common thread in the reviews is repeat work. One customer had Nick build a deck, tile a bathroom and remodel the kitchen. Another had him do every job in both his house and his barbershop. A third says every project around his house has exceeded his expectations, and he would not work with another contractor now. Reviewers call Nick a super nice guy who does great work.

services.h2: Bathroom remodeling in Pottstown and the rest of the house

items.name: Bathroom remodeling and tile
items.blurb: Bathrooms are a core specialty. Nick handles tile, plumbing and carpentry himself, so a remodel like this walk-in shower, with large-format wall tile, a pebble floor and a frameless glass door, can stay with one contractor from start to finish.

items.name: Kitchen remodeling
items.blurb: Kitchen renovations are the other half of what their Facebook page says they specialize in. One Google reviewer had Nick remodel the kitchen after he had already built the deck and tiled the bathroom. Call to talk through layout, cabinets, counters and floors.

about.text: Independence Renovations LLC. is a remodeling company on N Charlotte St in Pottstown, Pennsylvania, where customers work directly with Nick. One customer who has known him his whole life credits Nick's construction background, and says he does it all. On Facebook the company describes itself in its own words: quality craftsmanship, honest pricing, a name you can trust to get the job done right the first time, specializing in bathroom and kitchen renovations. The loyal German shepherd on their logo suits the reviews, which come from customers who keep calling Nick back.

process.h2: How a project with Nick works

steps.title: Call or message
steps.text: Call (484) 925-4872 or email Nick with what you want done, whether that is a bathroom, a kitchen, a deck or a repair.

steps.title: Walk through the job
steps.text: Nick looks at the space with you, talks through the work and the materials, and explains how he would handle it.

steps.title: Agree on the price
steps.text: You get a price for the work before it starts. Their Facebook page lists honest pricing as one of the things they stand for.

steps.title: Build
steps.text: Nick does the carpentry, tile, plumbing or concrete work the job needs. Reviewers describe the work as professional and completed in a timely manner.

steps.title: Next project
steps.text: Walk through the finished work together. Several of their reviewers went on to hire Nick for another room or project afterward.

faq.h2: Questions about working with Independence Renovations

items.q: What kind of work do you do?
items.a: Their Facebook page says they specialize in bathroom and kitchen renovations. Customers also describe decks, bathroom tile, concrete, carpentry and plumbing. One reviewer calls Nick an all-in-one contractor, so if your project spans several trades, you can talk the whole job through with him.

Yes. Tile is one of the most mentioned topics in their Google reviews, and their photos include a walk-in shower with large blue-gray wall tile, a pebble mosaic floor and a frameless glass door. Call Nick to talk through the tile and layout you have in mind for your bathroom.

Google lists Independence Renovations as open Monday through Saturday from 6 AM to 8 PM and Sunday from 9 AM to 6 PM. You can call (484) 925-4872 in those hours or email IndependenceRenovationsLLC@gmail.com with photos of your project at any time.

The business is based in Pottstown, and that is the town on its Google and Facebook pages. A longtime customer wrote that Nick will travel anywhere to build relations and show his work. If you live outside Pottstown, call and ask whether your location works.

Every job is different, so Nick looks at the work and gives you a price for it. Their Facebook page says the company stands for quality craftsmanship and honest pricing. Call or email with photos and a short description of what you want to get the conversation started.
